questions.question: Fill in the blank: DOM stands for Document ______ Model.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: The Document Object Model represents HTML documents as a tree of objects that can be manipulated with JavaScript.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: The Document Object Model represents HTML documents as a tree of objects that can be manipulated with JavaScript.
